Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 可是孟母注意：注意到，注意action vs.注意到result
- 他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩：祭拜着玩儿，V.着玩儿 do something just for fun
- 所以孟母决定他们会搬家：决定搬家
- 从早到晚很吵：都很吵

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 注意：注意到，When introducing a fact that someone came to notice, use the result complement in this verb pattern. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 祭拜玩：玩祭拜的游戏，The verb for playing an activity comes before the activity noun; it cannot follow the verb describing the activity. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 决定他们会搬家：决定搬家，After this verb, use the action phrase directly; do not repeat the people who will carry out the action. [teacher rule: jueding_vp]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子跟孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，跟他的妈妈，On first mention, introduce the character with a name and a clear description of who he is rather than assuming the reader already knows the family title. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他常常跟朋友们玩祭拜的游戏：孟子常常跟朋友们玩祭拜的游戏，Because both the mother and the child appeared in the previous sentence, repeat the name here so the pronoun is not ambiguous. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 注意到 correctly expresses that Mengmu came to notice the fact.
祭拜玩 needs the 着玩儿 construction here, while 玩祭拜的游戏 does not correctly express imitating worship for fun.
决定 should directly take the verb phrase 搬家 without repeating the subject and future modal.
This is the first mention of 孟子, so introducing him as a boy and identifying 孟母 as his mother is appropriate.
他 is not ambiguous here because the immediately relevant child is distinguished from 孟母 by gender, and the shown wording also retains the unsuitable 玩祭拜的游戏 expression.
